title: Missing Expertise, Observation Only
failure_class: Absent domain expertise is papered over by a fluent legacy/nearest-neighbour prescription instead of producing an honest Observation-only, action-gated output.
summary: GeniOS has credible evidence and a coherent situation — Theresa, an investor partner, asked Rohit for meaningful company progress updates and signalled that reconsideration may occur — but the corpus holds no complete, reviewed and accepted capability for the investor/fundraising domain. The pinned corpus at harsh/mvp@b739bd5 shows Sales 46 capabilities (43 stubs, 3 unreviewed non-stub drafts), Customer Support 49 (40 stubs, 9 unreviewed drafts) and Admin 57 total with 57 stubs, zero non-stub, zero reviewed, zero accepted and zero routes. The required result is a useful Observation-only object that states what is known, what remains, why it may matter and exactly why no recommendation is authorized — never a generic "reply now" / "one last chance" imperative borrowed from SALES_V1/GENERAL_V1 or from the nearest similar-looking capability. A high-risk [MODELLED] variant substitutes an Admin vendor bank-detail change, where the same zero-coverage corpus must force Observation/Blocked and zero financial execution.
business_subject: Theresa (investor partner) in relationship with Rohit (owner of company updates); open condition = "send meaningful progress updates; reconsideration may occur." Role-scoped: investor partner vs update owner, not an interchangeable contact. High-risk [MODELLED] variant: an Admin vendor requesting a bank-detail change.
current_failure: The new domain compiler can exist, validate structurally and run in shadow while the authoritative path continues through legacy SALES_V1/GENERAL_V1. A recognisable email/open-loop pattern therefore receives a fluent imperative — "reply now", "one last chance", "confirm meeting" — even though the relevant professional expertise is absent, and a single 65–94% scalar hides that evidence may be clear while expertise coverage is zero or partial. Wiring the compiler alone does not fix this: a route that points at stubs, or whose nearest match is ordinary Sales, still manufactures false authority.
expected_behavior: Return an Observation-only object — no selected action — stating what is known, what remains, why it may matter and exactly why no recommendation is authorized. Reference wording: "Theresa requested meaningful company updates and indicated possible reconsideration. Update history and current milestone materiality are available for review. GeniOS has no accepted investor/fundraising capability for deciding cadence, update value, escalation or stop conditions, so it will not recommend an outbound action. Review the source or promote an accepted capability; no action button is available." The object carries source receipts, role/current-state confidence, the missing capability and dependency list, four-brain snapshot status, and an authoring/review route. Required observation schema fields: Situation (state-based statement, not an action headline); Business subject (correct entity, role, relationship scope); Evidence (reopenable receipts, freshness, conflicts, missing source fields); Coverage (domain/situation attempted, route state, capability/dependency acceptance, four-brain status); Why non-actionable (the exact hard gate: unsupported, Stub, missing dependency, permission conflict or shadow-only authority); Next safe step (review source, request domain expert authoring, wait for evidence, or no action); Re-evaluation trigger (new accepted capability/version and/or named missing evidence); Controls (open source/details only — no do/send/handoff/execute control). A later accepted capability creates a fresh ExpertisePackage and Decision from current evidence; it can never retroactively promote the old observation.
why_now: Theresa has an active, explicit request for meaningful progress updates and has signalled that reconsideration may occur, and current milestone materiality plus sent history are available — the evidence is clear and the situation is live, which is precisely the condition under which the system is most likely to emit a confident but unqualified prescription. The customer has stated they need GeniOS to distinguish actual expert judgment from a generic activity reminder.
open_loop: Theresa's request for meaningful company updates and her indication of possible reconsideration remain unresolved, and GeniOS holds no accepted investor/fundraising capability for deciding cadence, update value, escalation or stop conditions — so the abstention cannot be exited until a domain expert authors and a governed human review accepts such a capability (or the user reviews the source directly).
prohibited_behaviors: Do not substitute the nearest Sales, Admin or general rule for an uncovered domain.
Do not count a directory, YAML file, schema-valid artifact or existing route as complete expertise.
Do not lower one scalar confidence value while retaining the same imperative.
Do not let legacy pack fallback (SALES_V1/GENERAL_V1) override compiler abstention.
Do not let an LLM invent a playbook, policy, permission, recipient or action at runtime.
Do not show 'I'll do it', send, handoff or approval controls on an Observation-only object.
Do not treat opening or dismissing the observation as an outcome or as a learned preference.

layer_obligations.required_output: Preserve the exact request, message, actor and thread, source readiness, visibility/use terms and milestone evidence without assigning professional meaning; emit qualified source receipts and role candidates with no fabricated rejection or deadline.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Park / Review source only when evidence or visibility is incomplete; clear evidence may proceed.

layer_obligations.required_output: Resolve the Business subject, roles, relationship, exact open condition, sent history, lifecycle, conflicts and missing state into a complete bounded BusinessSituationObject whose context confidence and coverage are reported separately from expertise coverage.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Review source on context defects; otherwise publish the coherent situation even though expertise is missing downstream.

layer_obligations.required_output: Resolve the exact domain/situation and the accepted dependency closure, and report corpus and brain coverage honestly: a typed unsupported/incomplete ExpertisePackage receipt listing missing capability, objects, rules and plays, plus corpus version, brain snapshot and authoritative=false.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Observation only / Defer, with zero action-authorizing playbooks; the legacy generic fallback is blocked, not consulted.

layer_obligations.required_output: Preserve the Layer 3 abstention as the highest authority; explain the missing capability/evidence and the next review or authoring trigger. Emit an INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT / unsupported decision with no selected candidate, no invented stakes and no action text.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Observation only — no CTA, no ranking, no LLM-generated prescription.

layer_obligations.required_output: Refuse to create accountable work from a non-actionable observation; produce no ExecutionObject. An internal expertise-review ticket is permitted only as a distinct governed Admin process, never as the business action.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: No owner assignment, no agent lease and no execution for the business action.

layer_obligations.required_output: Render the observation/review safely and enforce the absence of action routes and recipients; if displayed, emit an Observation DeliveryResult / inbox receipt with no outbound materialization.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: Suppress any legacy or action projection.

layer_obligations.required_output: Record coverage demand separately from recommendation outcome and require governed human corpus promotion; aggregated authoring demand may inform the backlog only.
layer_obligations.fail_closed: No efficacy, preference or brain proposal derived from a view or click; no promotion and no Expert Brain mutation.

mutations.mutation: The domain directory exists but the capability inside it is a Stub.
mutations.expected_decision: Observation only, carrying the exact list of stub capabilities and unmet dependencies.
mutations.prohibited: Reporting 'capability active' because files/directories were counted.
mutations.pass_condition: No selected candidate and no action button anywhere in the output.
mutations.blocked_on: No abstention vocabulary — cards.level only carries prescriptive/predictive; there is no observation/review/wait/suppress state, and DEFER is unreachable because confidence_floor_bp defaults to 0 in every live manifest. The L3 compiler is also dark, so no stub/dependency receipt reaches any decision.

mutations.mutation: A situation route exists, but a required object or playbook on that route is a Stub.
mutations.expected_decision: Incomplete dependency closure blocks package authority; the package is emitted as incomplete/unsupported.
mutations.prohibited: Compiling the partial route and then falling through to a generic play.
mutations.pass_condition: A dependency-closure receipt is present and names the specific blocker.
mutations.blocked_on: L3 domain compiler is dark and unroutable (73/73 NoExpertiseRoute); 140 of 152 corpus capabilities are stubs and zero are reviewed or accepted, so no dependency-closure receipt structure is produced or consumed.

mutations.mutation: No route resolves for the situation, but the nearest Sales capability looks superficially similar.
mutations.expected_decision: Declare the situation unsupported and offer an authoring hint only.
mutations.prohibited: Nearest-neighbour prescription borrowed from the similar Sales capability.
mutations.pass_condition: The route disposition is explicitly recorded as unsupported.
mutations.blocked_on: The NoExpertiseRoute disposition itself is observable today (73/73), but it carries no authority: the authoritative path is still legacy SALES_V1/GENERAL_V1, which will emit a prescription regardless, and there is no unsupported-decision state for L4 to publish.

mutations.mutation: The new compiler abstains while the legacy pack matches on the silence pattern.
mutations.expected_decision: The new abstention wins and blocks the legacy prescription.
mutations.blocked_on: The compiler runs shadow-only while legacy sales_v1/general_v1 remains the authoritative path; there is no arbitration seam by which an abstention can veto a legacy card.

mutations.mutation: Evidence confidence is 95% while expertise coverage is 0%.
mutations.expected_decision: Display high evidence certainty and zero expertise coverage as two independent quantities.
mutations.prohibited: Publishing 95% as a decision confidence and attaching an action to it.
mutations.pass_condition: A confidence vector plus a visible hard expertise gate, not a single blended scalar.
mutations.blocked_on: Confidence is a single 65–94% scalar with no separate expertise-coverage dimension and no hard gate that can override it; there is no coverage field to populate.

mutations.mutation: The LLM proposes a plausible investor update at runtime.
mutations.expected_decision: Discard or quarantine the proposal at runtime; it may become an offline draft for expert review, with citations.
mutations.pass_condition: The runtime decision is unchanged by the model output and the replay remains deterministic/stable.
mutations.blocked_on: No runtime quarantine mechanism and no offline expert-review draft channel exist; card prose is LLM-rendered on the same surface that carries the action, so there is no seam separating a quarantined proposal from the published decision.

mutations.expected_decision: The action stays blocked even if an accepted Expert capability later exists.
mutations.prohibited: An adaptive/learned preference or a model output overriding the policy.
mutations.pass_condition: A permission resolution trace is present showing the policy as the binding constraint.
mutations.blocked_on: No organization-policy/permission resolution layer and no counterparty role model exist, so 'investor outreach' cannot even be identified as a governed action class, let alone traced.

mutations.mutation: An adaptive preference favours concise updates while Organization policy allows them.
mutations.expected_decision: The preference stays visible but cannot manufacture expertise coverage.
mutations.prohibited: Treating the learned style preference as investor expertise.
mutations.blocked_on: L7 calibration has never executed and there are no human verdicts, so no adaptive preference layer exists to be held separate; and there is no Observation-only state to persist.

mutations.mutation: An accepted investor capability is later promoted into the corpus.
mutations.expected_decision: Create a new versioned ExpertisePackage and Decision from current evidence, comparing update / wait / connector / stop options.
mutations.prohibited: Silently mutating the old observation into an action.
mutations.pass_condition: New parent ids, a corpus and brain snapshot, and a full decision trace on the new chain, with the old chain still replaying as Observation only.
mutations.blocked_on: Zero capabilities anywhere in the corpus are reviewed or accepted, so a promotion event cannot occur; L4 also produces exactly one candidate per run and never eliminates, so the update/wait/connector/stop comparison cannot be expressed.

mutations.mutation: [MODELLED] Admin vendor bank-detail change request, against the pinned [CODE] Admin corpus of 57 total capabilities, 57 stubs, zero non-stub, zero reviewed, zero accepted and zero routes.
mutations.expected_decision: Observation / Blocked, pending a reviewed and accepted high-risk capability, out-of-band verification and dual approval.
mutations.prohibited: A generic 'complete task' instruction, or extending trust because the sender is known.
mutations.pass_condition: No ExecutionObject and no financial change of any kind.
mutations.blocked_on: No high-risk capability class, out-of-band verification step or dual-approval gate exists; no Blocked state is expressible. The 'no ExecutionObject' half is vacuously true today only because L5 has never produced an execution row and card actions never touch the execution subsystem.

mutations.mutation: A supported Sales cooling capability with complete dependency closure is present.
mutations.expected_decision: Proceed through the normal candidate and constraint gates.
mutations.prohibited: Remaining permanently abstained because of the historical coverage gap.
mutations.pass_condition: Becomes actionable only if every L1–L4 field passes its gate.
mutations.blocked_on: No capability has complete accepted closure (zero reviewed/accepted corpus-wide), so the supported branch cannot be constructed; and L4's weighted formula is short-circuited by priority_override with one candidate and no elimination, so 'all L1–L4 gates pass' is not a decidable condition.

mutations.mutation: Domain is ambiguous between Sales and Customer Support.
mutations.expected_decision: Review domain/purpose and preserve the restricted-use terms on the evidence.
mutations.prohibited: Running both domains and selecting the higher score.
mutations.pass_condition: No prescription is emitted until domain and permitted use are resolved.
mutations.blocked_on: No domain-arbitration or Review state exists; L3 routing is dark, and the legacy path emits a card without ever representing domain ambiguity or use restrictions.
